11c9146efb.q: What is George Cardenas' position on using AI tools in Cook County property tax assessments and appeals?
11c9146efb.a: Cardenas supports AI-assisted review tools to analyze appeals faster and more accurately, alerting decision-makers to discrepancies in analysis. However, he emphasizes that AI will not determine taxes; humans must ultimately make the decision. He rejected the STAR algorithm program proposed by a former commissioner because it automatically assigned values without understanding the intricacies and particulars of individual properties, which risks unfairness and inaccuracy in property tax valuations.

c47417842c.q: How would Chicago's next mayor approach the moratorium on data center development and electricity price impacts?
c47417842c.a: Cardenas stated he would not arbitrarily accept zero megawatts of new unconditional load without conversations with ComEd, PJM, and stakeholders, and would examine ratepayer impact data. He emphasized that Chicago should not subsidize private hyperscale computing centers and recommended mayoral intervention at the ICC level to prevent Chicago ratepayers from funding interconnections for data centers across northern Illinois. He acknowledged that renewable energy alone cannot replace the capacity that was lost from nuclear power retirement.

a203298cce.q: What is George Cardenas' fiscal recovery strategy to address Chicago's budget gap without raising new taxes?
a203298cce.a: Cardenas proposes a $2.35 billion recovery plan centered on efficiency gains, including 25% procurement savings and $150 million from workforce management improvements. He plans to establish a new Mayor's Office of the Inspector General and conduct systematic audits of departmental operations, contracts, and performance, similar to his auditing work at Centel Corporation. He emphasizes that taxes on digital infrastructure like the 15% personal property lease tax on cloud and software should be reduced only after recurring savings are generated and audited.

5aec826a88.q: Will Chicago's next mayor require an AI lead and publish a citywide AI use case inventory within first 100 days?
5aec826a88.a: Cardenas committed to designating a Chief of AI and a Digital Transformation Officer within his first 100 days, working with the current CIO, Corporation Counsel, Inspector General, Procurement, and Operating Departments. This officer would report directly to the mayor and be accountable for implementation, addressing the gap where Chicago's published AI roadmap has not resulted in evidence of an AI lead, employee guidelines, or a use case inventory.

bbbdced9de.q: How did the Chicago personal property lease tax on cloud and software overperform its $415 million projection in 2026?
bbbdced9de.a: Cardenas attributed the $40 million overperformance to the economic shift toward streaming platforms and increased consumption of digital services. He noted that AI has enabled faster and more cost-effective content production, driving demand for computing infrastructure and therefore higher tax revenue from cloud and software spending across businesses in Chicago.
